name: Vegas del Genil (Spain)
description: Light blue field with white wavy stripes at the hoist and the fly and a white central pale charged with the crowned municipal arms of Vegas del Genil (a bridge, a tree and waves).
history: Vegas del Genil adopted its arms and flag officially on 16 June 2004; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, light blue with white wavy stripes at the hoist and the fly and a white central stripe bearing the municipal arms.

features.role: Vegas del Genil arms — bridge, tree and waves
